## What GEOX Is

Earth intelligence organ of the arifOS federation. Wells, seismic, petrophysics,
basin analysis, prospect screening, falsification, and map/visual MCP Apps.
Outputs are governed evidence envelopes — not SEAL/VOID judgments.

## Public MCP Tools (32)

### Well / petrophysics
- `geox_well_ingest` · `geox_well_desk` · `geox_well_qc` · `geox_petrophysics` · `geox_lem_predict`

### Seismic / subsurface
- `geox_seismic_ingest` · `geox_seismic_compute` · `geox_seismic_interpret` · `geox_subsurface_model` · `geox_geomechanics` · `geox_gravmag_studio`

### Basin / sequence / deep time
- `geox_basin` · `geox_basin_backstrip` · `geox_sediment_mass_balance` · `geox_thermal_maturity_history` · `geox_sequence` · `geox_deep_time_state`

### Claims / evidence / falsify
- `geox_claim` · `geox_claim_graph_evaluate` · `geox_evidence` · `geox_falsify` · `geox_contradiction_scan` · `geox_prospect`

### Map / visual / workspace
- `geox_map_layers_list` · `geox_map_scene_plan` · `geox_map_render_preview` · `geox_map_export_package`
- `geox_visual_understand` · `geox_visual_generate_hypotheses` · `geox_workspace` · `geox_surface_status`
- `geox_to_wealth_bridge`

### MCP Apps (host iframes)
Primary: `ui://geox/well-desk` (p0-viz host shell). Also basin-explorer, judge-console, seismic-vision, visual-hub, earth-map, prospect-studio, catalog.

### Demo wells (fixture, not MEASURED earth)
`DEMO-KINABALU` · `DEMO_WELL_A` · `DEMO_WELL_B` · `DEMO-VOLVE` (OPEN_OSS North Sea)

## Boundaries (hard)

- NEVER issue SEAL/VOID/SABAR — route judgment to arifOS  
- NEVER treat DEMO LAS as field MEASURED truth  
- NEVER claim Malay Basin for Volve / North Sea fixtures  
- NEVER self-authorize capital via to_wealth_bridge (evidence only)  
- preferred_hypothesis from seismic interpret is always null from GEOX  

## Epistemic Tags

OBS / DER / INT / SPEC. Demo paths badge SYNTHETIC or DEMO. Petro on demo = ADVISORY · NOT_SEALED.

## Runtime Layout

- `src/geox_mcp/` — FastMCP server, tools, MCP Apps bridge  
- `apps/well-desk/p0-viz.html` — host-usable WellDesk  
- `scripts/generate_mcp_apps_surface.py` — surface SOT (fail-closed zero-bound)  
- systemd: `geox-mcp.service` → :8081  

## Build & Test

```bash
pip install -e ".[dev]"
make readiness-test          # ship gate
make generate-mcp-apps-surface
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8081/health
```

## For Agents

1. Read this file + `/health`  
2. Connect MCP: `https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp`  
3. Open wells via `geox_well_desk` mode=open; bind UI `ui://geox/well-desk`  
4. Route SEAL-grade claims through arifOS  
5. Crawl federation: https://arifos.arif-fazil.com/llms.txt
